title: Plan: post CPU-batch rejection fallback-byte reduction audit

basis.decision: Do not implement a large CPU batch runtime rewrite.

current_bottleneck_after_rejection.remaining_issue: The hot CPU kernel cannot save enough time by itself; the next viable route must reduce or eliminate fallback source bytes/calls, not only make the CPU dot loop faster.

next_audit_scope_before_code.candidate: fallback-byte elimination by resident exact up/down subset with a changed VRAM split
next_audit_scope_before_code.required_bound: Must include gate-cache penalty, model/context VRAM, source payload, workspace, and TTFT impact. Reject unless the combined bound exceeds 10 tok/s with at least 500 ms implementation slack.

next_audit_scope_before_code.candidate: exact GPU or hybrid execution for selected up/down experts
next_audit_scope_before_code.required_bound: Must prove both source delivery and exact/token-stable compute. Any GPU arithmetic must pass fixed-text top1 before performance. Reject if source bytes still require more than available NVMe/page-cache bandwidth or if VRAM residency is below the needed hotset coverage.

next_audit_scope_before_code.candidate: reduce fallback call count or source bytes through model/runtime placement
next_audit_scope_before_code.required_bound: Must quantify how many selected experts/calls are removed, the new CPU/GPU layer placement cost, and the TTFT delta. Do not benchmark blind cpu_moe/ngl sweeps already closed by prior audits.

hard_rules: Accepted 4.4 tok/s SOTA path remains unchanged by default.
No performance benchmark until a written bound shows a plausible route above both the current 4.4 tok/s SOTA and the 10 tok/s target class.
Every logit-changing path must pass fixed-text llama-results top1 equality before any strict cold benchmark.
Every strict cold benchmark must run under MemoryMax=16000000000 and MemorySwapMax=0, including page cache.

Any compliant new SOTA must be recorded with reproduction details, committed, pushed to https://github.com/wici-ai/ssd-llama.git branch vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb using L-Ark, and reproduced from pushed source.
immediate_next_action: Write and execute a fallback-byte reduction hard-bound artifact using the current fallback profile, accepted VRAM shape, and the rejected CPU-batch microprobe data. Do not write new runtime source before that artifact is complete.
